caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with three backrest sections, each formed by three horizontal wooden slats attached to vertical supports. The arms of the bench are curved, extending outward and slightly upward, and are adorned with tassel-like ornaments that hang downward. The seat appears to be woven, likely with a natural reed or straw material, and is rectangular in shape. The bench has six visible legs, four in the front and two in the back, each turned with simple decorative lines. Horizontal stretchers connect the legs near the base for stability, with one prominent central stretcher running the length of the bench and smaller ones connecting the legs widthwise. The entire bench is illustrated in shades of brown, with the wood grain and shadows indicated by darker tones, while the seat is shown with a lighter tan coloring. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, with a neutral light color.
title: Settee
